name: Mac stays usable
ownerWords:
look it's you and ops guys responsibility that this machine is usable.

you -harness side of bullshit, ops guy -app side of bullshit fixing monitoring

setup a 60min cadence duty
goal: No minute of the hour reads unusable in ops guy's pressure feed (pressure critical, 6,000+ swapouts a second, or kernel_task over one core). A minute with more than 14 agent turns working is the harness's, else the apps' or owner's: at 14 or fewer, 0 of 567 minutes on 10-14 and 10-15 were unusable.

metrics.label: Share of the last hour's minutes the Mac was usable
Unusable minutes this hour with over 14 agent turns working (harness side)
Unusable minutes this hour with 14 or fewer turns working (app or owner side)

onMiss: Push until green; never only report. Read the detail's harness_side and other_side lines. Harness minutes: start one fix job (await rlm.create_session(brief, name=..., cwd="/Users/sieunpark/Documents/Github/sieun-pi")) or message the live one an earlier run started. It finds why pi-pool let over 14 turns work (level read, owner turns, limit step, borrows), fixes pi-pool or the chat service with a test, commits, releases, and presses Run now until it reads 0. Other-side minutes: a harness owner on top gets the same job; an app owner (pm2, docker, dev server) or the owner's own app: tell this chat one line with the minutes, the owner and its GB for ops guy. Never kill a session mid-turn, restart the Prime daemon or :5182, or message another chat. All on target: end with no message.
